sharpened_to_avoid_collision: hairdresser was initially drafted as ספר (the traditional word), which collided with two existing bank entries (book AND barber, both already ספר). Rather than add a third meaning to an already-doubled homograph, hairdresser was changed to מעצב שיער (hair stylist) — a distinct, unambiguous, and equally natural modern Hebrew term. This is the one row in the batch where the translation itself was changed rather than tagged.
